summary: Return all own String and Symbol keys in [[OwnPropertyKeys]] order.

target.notes: Dispatch through the ECMAScript object/internal-method runtime so Proxy traps, property descriptors, coercion, abrupt completion, and boolean-vs-throw behavior are preserved.

semantics.return_value: new Array containing all own String and Symbol keys
semantics.ordering: uses target [[OwnPropertyKeys]] order; numeric index strings precede other strings for ordinary objects, Symbols follow strings
semantics.proxy: ownKeys trap may choose order subject to invariants

caveats: Do not replace this with C# reflection or ordinary property access when JavaScript object-model behavior is observable.

tests.name: includes non-enumerable and symbols
tests.expected_behavior: prints string,string,string,symbol for ordinary object keys including hidden and Symbol
